items.title: Ondo Forge Base Body (female): Underwear Turnaround
items.caption: Front, three-quarter, side and back views of the female Ondo Forge body without outfit, hair or headgear, in a grey sports top and shorts, redrawn from the female turnaround of the Ondo Forge reference sheet. The reference the 3D base body is built to; clothes and hair are separate parts. Prototype design, not locked canon.
items.prompt: ChatGPT, 2026-11-13, sixth redraw in one conversation. The first message attached the Ondo Forge reference sheet and its female turnaround and asked for the same adult dwarf woman's base body with outfit, hair and headgear taken off, as a neutral modeling reference; redraws two to five corrected leg, hip and arm widths against that turnaround. The sixth message (attached: the reference turnaround, the fifth image, and the fifth image with four blue marks drawn 18 % wider at the shoulder tips) was: Measured again over the reference. The legs of your latest image are good in the front view: keep them. One thing is left: the SHOULDERS. They are as narrow as in your first redraw. In the reference her shoulders, under the shoulder armour, are clearly wider, and her arms hang further out from the body. Attached: first the reference turnaround, second your latest image, third your latest image again with four blue marks that I drew on it. Redraw the latest image (the second attached image) on the same canvas, the same four views in the same places. Head, face, neck, height, waist, hips, legs, feet, and the thickness and length of the arms and hands stay exactly as in the latest image. Fix ONLY the shoulders: 1. Front view and back view: widen the shoulders until each shoulder tip (the outer end of the shoulder line, where the arm begins) reaches the blue mark on its side in the third attached image. That is about one sixth wider than now. 2. The chest and the upper back widen with the shoulders. The waist stays as it is, so the torso tapers a little more from the shoulders down to the waist. 3. Both arms hang from the new shoulder tips: each whole arm with its hand moves outward by the same distance as its shoulder tip, at the same angle as now. The gap between each arm and the body stays open. 4. Three-quarter view: the shoulders wider by the same share. Side view: no change. The blue marks are only a guide for you: do not draw them in the new image. Change nothing else: same bald head, same grey sports top and shorts, same bare skin, same line work, same paper background, no text, no ground shadow. Landscape 3:2 image, the same framing.

items.title: Furral Galvanic Scout (male): Character Sheet
items.caption: Male Furral scout, the third character of the 3D character factory: fox head with a muzzle, big ears and a bushy tail, short brick-red double-breasted jacket, belt with two pouches, copper wrist wraps, fingerless gloves, dark trousers, brass-toed boots. About five heads tall. Prototype design, not locked canon.
items.prompt: ChatGPT, 2026-11-12, two messages. First: Character design sheet on a plain off-white paper background, 3:4 portrait. Left, filling 90 percent of the frame height: one large full body view of one lean young adult male fox-like beastfolk with a furry fox head, a short muzzle, large upright ears with cream inner fur, golden-orange fur with cream on the muzzle, cheeks and throat, and a short bushy golden-orange tail with a cream tip that hangs close behind the legs and ends above the knee, standing relaxed, arms slightly away from the body, hands open. The head is one fifth of total body height. Short tousled golden-orange head fur between the ears, no long hair. Bright teal eyes, calm confident face. Hip-length rust-brown double-breasted jacket with a standing collar, cream piping and brass buttons, sleeves ending at the elbow, a short dark brown neck scarf tucked inside the collar with no hanging ends. Wide brown leather belt with two flat pouches and one brass buckle. Fitted charcoal trousers. Brown leather knee boots with brass toe caps. Copper wire bracers wrapped around both forearms, dark brown fingerless gloves. Top right: head and shoulders close-up of the same face. Middle right: one small full body version of the same character, two heads tall, same outfit. Bottom right: three small full body views in a row, front, side and back, same outfit. A faint pale grey emblem behind the large figure. A soft grey shadow under every figure. Anime character design sheet, hand-painted digital illustration with fine dark outlines, soft cel shading, sharp line highlights and visible fabric texture. Clear colours with warm accents. No text, no letters, no logo, no watermark Correction (version 2, the stored image): Please redraw the same character design sheet: same character, same outfit, same colours, same layout. Fix only the proportions. He is a short, small-bodied beastfolk, only five heads tall: the head (chin to top of the head fur, not counting the ears) is one fifth of total body height. Larger head, shorter torso, much shorter legs, still lean, still a young adult male. Keep the tail short and ending above the knee, the jacket ending at the hip, both hands empty and open. Make the two belt pouches flat against the hips. No backpack, no weapon, nothing held, no chains, no glow, no sparks, no text.

items.title: Furral Galvanic Scout (male): Turnaround
items.caption: Front, side and back A-pose turnaround of the male Furral scout, made from the character sheet. These three views are the input of the 3D body generation. Prototype design, not locked canon.
items.prompt: ChatGPT, 2026-11-12, same conversation as the character sheet: Create a clean 3D-modeling orthographic turnaround sheet of the same character and outfit as the image above (the five-heads-tall version), prepared for 3D game character generation. Landscape 3:2 image split into three equal columns: Front view, Left Side view, Back view, all the same height, full body from the ear tips to the boot soles, same outfit and colours in every view. 1. HEAD AND FUR: keep the face; short head fur only, no long hair, so the whole neck, collar and upper back are visible. 2. STRICT SYMMETRICAL A-POSE: arms straight, 40 degrees out from the torso, open relaxed empty hands, clear white space between the arms and the waist. Legs straight and shoulder-width apart, with clear white space between the calves, ankles and boots in the Front and Back views (no crossed legs, no touching heels). 3. TAIL: one short bushy tail that ends above the knee, hanging straight down close behind the legs; hidden behind the body in the Front view so it does not cover the legs, clearly visible in the Left Side and Back views. 4. STUDIO BACKGROUND: pure flat #FFFFFF white, no ground shadow, no floor line, no emblem, no borders, no text. No backpack, no weapon, nothing held, no glow, no sparks.

items.title: Six Races Lineup: Twelve Travellers at True Height
items.caption: Left to right, a man then a woman of each race: Maro Folk, Ondo Forge, Linde Folk, Daro Guard, Tava Kin, Silme Seers. Relative heights for the 3D prototype; designs are preferred prototypes, not locked canon. Ondo Forge redrawn taller at the owner's request.
items.prompt: Wide landscape image, 16:9, plain off-white paper background with one thin pale grey ground line across the bottom 8 percent of the frame. Twelve full body adult characters stand in one single row on that ground line, all facing the camera, arms relaxed, evenly spaced, with no gaps wider than one figure. The row is six pairs, a man then a woman in each pair, from left to right: pair one is the version 2 human pair from this conversation, blue, cream and gold adventurer outfits, friendly faces, the woman with long hair and a lightly fitted outfit that shows little skin; pair two is the short and sturdy pair with the short beard version B man from this conversation, young faces, red hair, work goggles on the forehead; pair three is the slim pointed-ear pair from this conversation; pair four is the large broad-shouldered pair from this conversation; pair five is the dog-eared beastfolk pair from this conversation with the exact ear design already chosen; pair six is the pale-haired pair from this conversation. Heights as a share of the frame height, measured from the ground line to the top of the head: pair four man 85 percent, woman 78 percent; pairs one, three and six men 68 percent, women 63 percent; pair five man 62 percent, woman 58 percent, ears not counted; pair two man 46 percent, woman 43 percent. Keep each design exactly as last shown in this conversation, same faces, hair, colours and outfits, nothing redrawn from scratch. A soft grey shadow under every figure. Anime character design sheet, hand-painted digital illustration with fine dark outlines, soft cel shading, sharp line highlights and visible fabric texture. Clear colours with warm accents. No text, no letters, no labels, no numbers, no height ruler, no logo, no watermark. Owner edit in the chat afterwards: the short sturdy pair was too small, so pair two was redrawn taller, measured about 49 and 45 percent of the frame height, 81 percent of the pair one man.
